Senses.Explanation: A counter-pointer's twin — arrived, and so not pointed out — staged at the root as the general's true command, answered over the midnight sun, set against the whole storehouse, and opened fourfold from the Song case-desks to the Qing evening seats. The root sits in Xuedou Chongxian's own staged answers, in the case-raising section of his Mingjue record: two blades crossing, out to settle living and dying, neither side hurt, no merit established — what is the general's true command? the staged answer: arrived, and so not pointed out; and when the line is raised again — does arrived-not-pointed satisfy you? — the answer: red heart, shard on shard; Yunfeng Wenyue, in his record carried among the old worthies, meets the midnight query — the golden crow never surely at noon, the jade rabbit never dark at midnight; what then? — with the pointing half: pointed, and so not arrived; the monk goes silent; do you get it? no — and then the arrival half is given; Yuanwu Keqin pairs the halves against the two treasuries: pointed-not-arrived is the whole storehouse — flowers laid on brocade; arrived-not-pointed is the patriarch come from the west — bronze voice, jade ring; and are the patriarch's intent and the teaching's intent the same or different? the deepest pool's cloud: beyond, unrelated; Juelang Daosheng, at the refuge-taking of the two scholar-officials, opens the field for choosing sages — who enters first? ask the outsider; the one of no skill begs the reaching hand to gather him in, and the twin is given whole: pointed-not-arrived, arrived-not-pointed; the bowing monk thanks the grandmotherly heart and is ruled a gate-crasher not allowed here. Yingning Zhijing walks the four positions for the questioning layman — guest in host, host in guest, guest in guest, host in host: the robed one holding the subtle purport, the quiet step kicking the paired lights — then the ascent: guest and host shown by the master; is there a further matter? the sky low at the sea's rim; and the fault? arrived, not pointed; a snowflake flying at the red furnace is answered with the pointing half, and the master leaps down from the seat; Shending Yikui, at the evening instruction: lightning rolls and stars race — arrived, not pointed; a whisker of thinking — pointed, not arrived; and once both ends are sat through and the one cleft of the upward split open, one sentence holds the three mysteries, one mystery holds the three essentials — name that cleft; weigh it rightly and you shame no Shending trainee; miss it, and Zhengzhou pears and Qingzhou dates mostly will not pass for a source; and Yulin Tongxiu, at the evening seat, gives the twin weight for weight — pointed-not-arrived, one sentence wounding kindness; arrived-not-pointed, every word a standing wall — then opens the fourfold: both arriving and pointing, the moon bright over the autumn sky; neither arriving nor pointing, the wind across sea and ridge; and the assembly asked what this winter retreat owes a whole life — a long stillness, then the sudden shout; asking and answering not recorded.
